question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Accomplish**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Accomplish **means to successfully complete or achieve a task, goal, or objective. (किसी कार्य, लक्ष्य या उद्देश्य को सफलतापूर्वक पूरा करना या प्राप्त करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *After months of hard work and dedication, she was able to accomplish her goal of running a marathon.*
 
 
 
• So, in this context, the term "**accomplish**" is used in a broader sense to encompass the achievement of collective desires or wishes.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Give up: **To surrender, relinquish, or stop pursuing a task or goal. (किसी कार्य या लक्ष्य का पीछा करना, समर्पण करना, त्यागना या बंद करना)
 
• **Escalate: **To increase in intensity, scope, or severity, often referring to a conflict or situation. (तीव्रता, दायरे या गंभीरता में वृद्धि, अक्सर किसी संघर्ष या स्थिति का संदर्भ देती है)
 
• **Evacuate: **To move people or objects out of a place of danger or emergency. (लोगों या वस्तुओं को खतरे या आपात्कालीन स्थान से बाहर ले जाना)
